name: Cart Popup for WooCommerce
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Cart Popup for WooCommerce adds a Cart icon accross site at bottom that displays the count of added products in the cart.
Users can manage all the cart items directly from the Cart Popup for WooCommerce.

Features And Options:

  • Display all added product items in Cart Popup for WooCommerce.
  • View Cart, Empty Cart and Proceed to Checkout Button.
  • Choose position for cart popup Left,Right and Center.
  • Remove added items without refreshing page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the “Cart Popup for WooCommerce” plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Click on Cart Popup for WooCommerce on the dashboard.
sections.faq:
How to setup Plugin?

Does not required any setup. Just activate the plugin and set the postion of popup to display.
